characterDesign.description: Young adult male farmer, Asian phenotype starting point, medium build, blue polo shirt, olive trousers, brown work boots and short dark chestnut hair.
characterDesign.note: The MPFB output is a new exploratory style candidate and does not reproduce or pass acceptance against the approved stylized reference design.

knownIssues: Face has visible forehead texture artifacts and generic facial expression.
Eye appearance is not expressive enough for the approved stylized farming-game target.
Body proportions are more realistic than the approved 3.5-4-head SEMESTA style guide.
The current MPFB rig has not been retargeted or validated against semesta-humanoid-v2.0.
No Idle, Walk, Run, or Interact animations are present.
Clothing deformation and shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee, ankle and neck poses have not been reviewed.
